The query sums code violations for 2024 and 2025 separately per tract from observations, computes the 2025 minus 2024 increase, left joins all tracts so missing years read as zero, and ranks tracts by that increase descending.
sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT geoid,
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS code_violations_2024,
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS code_violations_2025
  FROM fw_pg.tract_observations
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_9f74a6' AND source = 'm1_city' AND geoid IS NOT NULL AND value_kind = 'count' AND year IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT t.name AS tract_name,
       (COALESCE(y.code_violations_2025, 0) - COALESCE(y.code_violations_2024, 0)) AS increase_in_code_violations,
       COALESCE(y.code_violations_2024, 0) AS code_violations_2024,
       COALESCE(y.code_violations_2025, 0) AS code_violations_2025,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN yearly y ON t.geoid = y.geoid
ORDER BY increase_in_code_violations DESC, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
